Class ParitySlotRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.core.ParitySlotRegistry
@Internal public final class ParitySlotRegistry extends Object
The side-neutral registry of container-parity slot recipes — the single source of truth both menu-build seams read so a registered slot appears on every menu the player opens, identically on both sides.

The two seams, one registry

A registered SlotSpec must materialise as a real MKCSlot on three kinds of menu, and this registry is what each path applies:
  • The player's own InventoryMenu — appended by the library-owned MKCInventoryMenuMixin at the menu constructor's TAIL, on both sides. This is the §0019 line container parity deliberately crosses: the inventory menu is built in the player constructor (never via openMenu), so the projection seam can't reach it; rather than make every consumer write the same InventoryMenu.<init> mixin, the library owns it once and drives it from this registry. (Foreign menus keep no consumer-ownable per-menu seam, so they were already library-owned via MKCSlotProjection.)
  • Every foreign menu (chest/furnace/donkey/modded) — appended by a single MKCSlotProjection source (registered once by MKCContainerPanel) whose factory calls applyTo(AbstractContainerMenu, Player); its appliesTo excludes InventoryMenu so the inventory menu isn't double-served.
  • The creative item-picker — gets the slots for free: the existing MKCCreativeSlotItemPickerMixin wraps whatever MKCSlots the InventoryMenu mixin already put on player.inventoryMenu.

Sync safety

Both real seams build through MKCSlots with the same recipe in the same registry order, and the storage factory yields the same size per player on both sides — so the appended slot blocks are byte-identical, the invariant MKCSlotProjection spells out. applyTo(AbstractContainerMenu, Player) is called at most once per menu instance: the inventory mixin fires once per construction; the projection source is guarded per-menu by MKCSlotProjection.

    • register

      public static void register(String slotPanelId, SlotSpec spec)
      Registers one parity slot recipe. The slotPanelId is the id the built MKCSlots carry (and the SlotElements resolve against) — MKCContainerPanel derives it from the container-panel id + group so it's stable and collision-free.

    • applyTo

      public static void applyTo(net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu menu, net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player)
      Builds every registered recipe's slots onto menu for player, via the proven MKCSlots path (so render / click→Storage / creative / sync all ride the same vanilla-slot machinery the inventory slot already uses). Invoked by the inventory-menu mixin (every InventoryMenu) and by the projection source (every foreign menu); each call site guarantees a given menu instance is applied at most once.
